fine_lines.title: a / an vs some
fine_lines.explanation_ar: نستخدم a أو an مع الشيء المفرد (a sofa, an oven)، ونستخدم some مع الجمع (some cupboards, some drawers) ومع furniture.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Use a/an with one thing. Use some with plurals and with furniture.

examples.sentence: You need a fridge and an oven.

fine_lines.title: a vs an
fine_lines.explanation_ar: نستخدم an قبل الكلمة التي تبدأ بصوت حرف علة: an oven. وa قبل الصوت الساكن: a lamp.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Use an before a vowel sound (an oven), a before a consonant sound (a lamp).

fine_lines.title: have got vs has got
fine_lines.explanation_ar: مع I / you / we / they نستخدم have got، ومع he / she / it نستخدم has got. والاختصار: I've got / She's got.
fine_lines.explanation_en: I/you/we/they + have got; he/she/it + has got. Short: I've got, she's got.

examples.sentence: I've got a sofa in my living room.
She's got a bed and a lamp in her bedroom.

fine_lines.title: wardrobe vs cupboard
fine_lines.explanation_ar: wardrobe = خزانة الملابس في غرفة النوم، وcupboard = خزانة للأطباق والطعام (غالبًا في المطبخ).
fine_lines.explanation_en: A wardrobe is for clothes; a cupboard is for things like plates and food.

examples.sentence: My clothes are in the wardrobe.
The plates are in the cupboard.

grammar.title: have got / has got
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم have got / has got لنقول ما نملكه، وهي شائعة في الإنجليزية البريطانية. I've got a sofa. She's got a bed. والسؤال: What have you got? What's she got?
grammar.explanation_en: Use have got / has got to say what you have (common in British English). Questions: What have you got? What's she got?
examples: I've got a sofa, a bookshelf, a TV and a rug.
She's got a bed, a lamp, a bedside table and a wardrobe.
What has Georgie got in her living room?
You've got a fridge, some cupboards, an oven and a microwave.

grammar.title: I need + a / an / some
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم need + اسم لنقول ما نحتاجه: a/an مع المفرد، وsome مع الجمع.
grammar.explanation_en: Use need + noun: a/an for one thing, some for plurals.

grammar.title: Lists with commas and and
grammar.explanation_ar: عند ذكر عدة أشياء نفصل بينها بفواصل ونضع and قبل آخر شيء.
grammar.explanation_en: In a list, use commas and put and before the last item.
examples: I've got a table, four chairs and some drawers.
She's got a sofa, a bookshelf, a TV and a rug.
